title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: amendment deadline, amendment fee and re-review after a change of sailing
content:
## Amendment deadline
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product an amendment is accepted only when it is signed no later than the category's amendment cut-off hours before the cargo cut-off of the booking's sailing. The amendment deadline is the cargo cut-off time less the category's cut-off hours, counted as full 60-minute hours in port-of-loading local time, and an amendment signed exactly at the deadline is accepted. The deadline governs both the amendment and its fee, and the cargo cut-off relied on is the one recorded on the booking concerned.

## Amendment fee
An amendment is free while the signed amendments already counted on the acceptance are below the category's number of free amendments, and otherwise costs the category's amendment fee, referencing the amendment submission.

## Change of sailing
When the booking moves to another sailing and the category re-reviews on a change of sailing, an approved acceptance returns to review and is charged the category's re-review fee once for that change of sailing, with no submission reference.

## Retired clause
The earlier clause "amendment and re-review fees may be booked only while the acceptance is submitted, under review or approved" is **no longer in force**. The status conditions on which an amendment fee or a re-review fee may be booked follow the current basis for the amendment fee.

## Boundary cases on the deadline (hypothetical 60-hour window)
Cargo cut-off: 9 June at 06:00, port-of-loading local time. The deadline is 60 full hours earlier: 6 June at 18:00 local time.
| Amendment signed (port-of-loading local time) | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 6 June 17:59 | accepted |
| 6 June 18:00 | accepted — exactly at the deadline |
| 6 June 18:01 | not accepted |

## Free or charged — worked sequence (hypothetical allowance of 1 free amendment)
| Amendment | Signed amendments counted before it | Below the allowance of 1 | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| first | 0 | yes | free |
| second | 1 | no | the category's amendment fee |

With a hypothetical allowance of 0, the first amendment already costs the fee, since 0 is not below 0.

## Basis Q&A
- *Does a re-review after a change of sailing reference a declaration?* No; it is charged with no submission reference.
- *How many re-review fees arise from one change of sailing?* One.
